# What rskj's release answers to read-only calls, request by request.
#
# Its own JSON-RPC server (rskj-core 9.0.4-VETIVER, as released) answered
# these over the Web3 its RskContext builds on regtest, with block 1 as the
# head and the accounts listed in its state. The scenario
# "short-before-rskip136" is "short" again, run with
# blockchain.config.consensusRules.rskip136=-1.
#
#   scenario <name>
#   head <number> <gas limit> <minimum gas price>
#   account <name> <address> <nonce> <balance> [<code>], or "none" for an
#     account the state doesn't hold
#   call <label> <method> <params> => <the whole answer>
#
# probe and seven return seven words: BALANCE(CALLER), BALANCE(ADDRESS),
# CALLVALUE, GASPRICE, CALLER, ORIGIN and SELFBALANCE. payback sends its
# caller 1 and returns BALANCE(CALLER) and whether the sending worked. echo
# reverts with the data it is called with, and hashofcaller returns
# EXTCODEHASH(CALLER). selfbal returns SELFBALANCE, and relay calls its
# caller and returns what the caller returns. The address 3bd52ac9...4d5a,
# the sender of many calls, has no account.
#
# In the scenario "spend", fwd and fwd1 send 1 to the address dead, with no
# gas beside the stipend, and return whether that worked. relayback calls
# its caller back with the value it was sent and returns what the caller
# returns. The rest are there for what their estimates come to:
#   sstores                   stores 1 in a cell, then 0
#   sstoresthencalls          the same, then calls its caller with all its gas
#   callsfixed                calls its caller with 100,000 gas
#   callsall                  calls the address dead with all its gas
#   proxyfixed, proxyall      DELEGATECALL the address dead: 100,000 gas, all
#   staticfixed               STATICCALLs it with 100,000 gas
#   callcodevalue             fwd's call, as a CALLCODE
#   fwdreverts                fwd's call, and then a REVERT
#   creates                   CREATEs a contract of no code
#   createsvalue              the same, with a value of 1
#   createsthencallsall       creates, then calls the address dead with all gas
#   createsvaluethencallsall  the same, creating with a value of 1
#   createscalling            CREATEs with a constructor that is callsall
#   createsforwarding         CREATEs with a constructor that is fwd, then
#                             calls the address dead with all its gas
#
# In the scenario "zerocode", the zero address and creator hold a program
# that CREATEs a contract of no code and returns its address. The creations
# there run relay's code as their constructor.
scenario calls
